parts:
All,
This unfortunately is a fairly vague question, but I am not sure how to proceed.
I have modeled raven abundance over 20 years with factors on initial abundance, gamma, and omega. There of course are also detection covariates. The best dynamics are Gompertz. I am certain I can make a raster stack using the raster package and predict abundance for the initial year; however, is there an easy way to get a predicted raster for all subsequent years (t=2 through 20)? I am currently trying to determine if it is possible to get a raster surface of density or relative abundance for each year before going down the rabbit hole.

The data is BBS,which also means 'abundance' was quantified across the entire line and I haven't thought through how to align the size of the output raster cells with the length of the BBS line. The 'abundance' is also more of an index as the survey is on roads. Thanks for any input.
